title: Archive 1 · Revisit 1
description: Find the fields belonging to the shelter book. Show each field and what it stores, alphabetically by field.

title: Archive 1 · Revisit 2
description: Find the fields marked as an identifier. Show each book and field, alphabetically by book, then field.

title: Archive 2 · Revisit 1
description: Find the bus fields tagged 'none' — they can't pick out a record alone. List their names alphabetically.

title: Archive 2 · Revisit 2
description: Find every field tagged 'spare', a backup identifier. Show its book and field, alphabetically by book, then field.

title: Archive 3 · Revisit 1
description: Find links pointing to the shelter book. Show each link's from_book and from_field, alphabetically by both.

title: Archive 3 · Revisit 2
description: Find links pointing to the ward book. Show each link's from_book and from_field, alphabetically by both.

title: Archive 4 · Revisit 1
description: Find edits that changed a book's contents. Show the target and edit, newest first; undated edits come last.

title: Archive 4 · Revisit 2
description: Find edits that built a book. Show the target and edit, alphabetically by target.

title: Archive 5 · Revisit 1
description: Find where read access is explicitly refused. Show the who and record_book, alphabetically by both.

title: Archive 5 · Revisit 2
description: Find who is allowed to write. Show the who and record_book, alphabetically by both.

title: Archive 6 · Revisit 1
description: Find closed stalls in ward K-7. List their identification numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 6 · Revisit 2
description: Find open stalls with a known ward outside K-7. List their identification numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 7 · Revisit 1
description: List each known home ward once for pilgrims arriving after day two. Arrange ward names alphabetically.

title: Archive 7 · Revisit 2
description: List each known home ward once for pilgrims arriving before day three. Arrange ward names in reverse alphabetical order.

title: Archive 8 · Revisit 1
description: Find shops whose names begin with Paper, regardless of capital letters. List their names alphabetically.

title: Archive 8 · Revisit 2
description: Find shops whose trade descriptions end with ink, regardless of capital letters. List their names alphabetically.

title: Archive 9 · Revisit 1
description: Find sealed vaults in wards D-1 or D-3. List their identification numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 9 · Revisit 2
description: Find unsealed vaults with known wards outside D-1, D-3, and D-9. List their identification numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 10 · Revisit 1
description: Show the second and third most valuable finds with their coin values, most valuable first. Break value ties alphabetically by item name.

title: Archive 10 · Revisit 2
description: Show the two least valuable finds with their coin values, least valuable first. Break value ties alphabetically by item name.

title: Archive 11 · Revisit 1
description: Show each dish with its notes written in small letters. Arrange dishes alphabetically.

title: Archive 11 · Revisit 2
description: Show each dish with the first three characters of its notes. Arrange dishes alphabetically.

title: Archive 12 · Revisit 1
description: Show each pump with the magnitude of its backup flow, ignoring the sign. Treat missing backup flow as zero; arrange pumps by identification number.

title: Archive 12 · Revisit 2
description: Show each pump with its main flow rounded to the nearest whole number. Treat missing main flow as zero; arrange pumps by identification number.

title: Archive 13 · Revisit 1
description: For each departure day, count trains whose names are recorded. Show the date and count, earliest day first.

title: Archive 13 · Revisit 2
description: For each known departure day, find its earliest departure time. Show the date and that time, earliest day first.

title: Archive 14 · Revisit 1
description: Count the lots belonging to each crop. Show the crop and lot count, alphabetically by crop.

title: Archive 14 · Revisit 2
description: Find the largest number of crates in a single lot for each crop. Show the crop and amount, alphabetically by crop.

title: Archive 15 · Revisit 1
description: Find heaps containing at most 800 kilograms of recovered metal in total. List heap numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 15 · Revisit 2
description: Find heaps with more than one metal record. List heap numbers in increasing order.

title: Archive 16 · Revisit 1
description: For every bin, count parcels lighter than 20 kilograms, including bins with none. Show bin names and counts, alphabetically by bin.

title: Archive 16 · Revisit 2
description: For every bin, count parcels whose weight is unknown, including bins with none. Show bin names and counts, alphabetically by bin.

title: Archive 17 · Revisit 1
description: Show each line, rider, tap total, and placing. Highest totals lead each line; ties share places without gaps. Arrange by line, placing, then rider.

title: Archive 17 · Revisit 2
description: Show each line, rider, tap total, and position. Number riders within each line by highest totals, breaking ties alphabetically. Arrange by line, then position.

title: Archive 18 · Revisit 1
description: Show each reading’s hour, signal, and following signal in time order. The last reading has no following value.

title: Archive 18 · Revisit 2
description: Show each reading’s hour, signal, and accumulated signal total up to that hour, earliest first.

title: Archive 19 · Revisit 1
description: Find wells shallower than the average depth. Show their identification numbers and depths, shallowest first; break ties by identification number.

title: Archive 19 · Revisit 2
description: Find all wells at the smallest known depth. Show their identification numbers and depths, arranged by identification number.

title: Archive 20 · Revisit 1
description: Show every tower with its number of attached spans, including towers with none. Arrange tower names alphabetically.

title: Archive 20 · Revisit 2
description: Show tower names and span numbers for attached spans only. Arrange alphabetically by tower name, then by span number.
